title: Source control, branch protection and secure SDLC
workflow: Link engineering issue to approved scope and requirements
Develop in isolated branch with controlled dependency versions
Run code tests, static checking and secret scans
Require independent review and protected-branch gates
Create signed/provenance-attested release artifact where supported
Promote only with accountable release authorization
invariants: A generated design ZIP is not a tested software release
No direct unreviewed production patch under routine permissions
Secrets, private credentials and customer data cannot enter Git history
Financial changes require extra CFO/test gate where applicable
All release artifacts identify exact source commit and build environment
Failed CI checks must block merge rather than be suppressed
planned_tests: Release digest links to source commit
Unapproved user cannot bypass reviewer requirement
approval_gate: Organization repository policy, actual CI runtime, independent maintainers and executed check evidence.
